critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1525 lines — strongly recommend splitting into routers (auth, products, orders, tasks, audit, analytics) for maintainability.
POST /api/orders/{oid}/cancel still has no role gating — any authenticated user (incl. staff) can cancel any order, restocking inventory and reversing customer balance. Carry-over from iter 2.
PATCH /api/tasks/{id} still has no permission check — any logged-in user can update/reassign any task. Only DELETE is gated. Carry-over from iter 2.
PATCH /api/orders/{oid}/status accepts any status transition with no validation (e.g., can jump cancelled→completed) and no role check.
log_event() is fire-and-forget but awaited inline — failed audit writes won't fail requests but they do block the response on Mongo round-trip. For high-traffic ops consider asyncio.create_task().
audit_logs collection has no TTL/retention; will grow unbounded. Consider TTL index on created_at or rolling cleanup.
Audit log 'q' search uses plain $regex (case-insensitive but unanchored) — fine for now but un-indexed regex on large collections becomes slow; consider a text index on summary if logs grow.

make_invoice_no() second-precision + 4-hex-char suffix: collision space is 16^4=65536 — fine for normal POS volume, but unique-index DuplicateKey would still raise 500 (no retry). Consider a small retry loop or use uuid4 hex.
